caption: The drawing depicts a single lantern placed centrally on a plain, light background. The lantern consists of a rounded, clear glass globe held in place by metal bands that wrap horizontally and vertically around it, forming a protective cage-like structure. The lantern has a cylindrical metal base with two concentric circular steps and small perforations near the bottom edge. The top of the lantern is capped with a perforated, cylindrical metal chimney that has additional horizontal slots for ventilation. A thin, tall, arched metal handle is attached at two opposite points near the top, extending in a wide loop above the lantern. The entire drawing is rendered in grayscale, providing detailed shading and highlights to suggest the reflective surfaces of metal and glass. The background is unadorned, with slight discolorations and minor spots, and there is a small, light inscription in the lower left corner.
title: Hand Lantern
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
